subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-07-30
html:
PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/services/solo-business-owner (fix)Meta description, og/twitter tags, hero subhead, a benefits card, the signup step, and two FAQs all still advertised the retired "$19/mo Solo" tier and a "$99/mo Studio" upgrade prompt — a prospect landing here and then checking /pricing would have seen two different pricing stories. Rewrote every instance to match the live "free during early access, no card" model already on /pricing and billing.ts.accuracy fix, not keyword-targetedaskarlo.app/services/solo-business-owner
/services/agency-owner (fix)FAQ said "ARLO is priced per seat with agency plans for 10+ users" — the exact per-seat vs. per-business-tracked contradiction the original 2026-07-04 audit flagged and that had stayed unfixed for 4 weeks. Replaced with the free-during-early-access framing.accuracy fix, not keyword-targetedaskarlo.app/services/agency-owner

Needs your attention (new this session): each of the 6 persona pages has a second, unused copy of its content sitting in src/app/services/{slug}/route.ts + _content + _shell.html — a scaffold matching the newer template pattern used for /pricing, /blog, /compare, etc. It looks like an abandoned or paused migration: the real live pages still render from the older src/content/services.ts template. I fixed the pricing in both copies so neither one is wrong, but someone should decide whether to finish promoting these 6 pages to the newer template or delete the dead scaffold — right now it's a trap where stale content could get "fixed" in a file that never actually renders.

Needs your attention (unchanged, now 5 sessions old): the Jul 18 product commit wired real OAuth for 9 new connectors (Meta Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, MailerLite, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Clarity, GTM), but src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts still marks most of them coming_soon/waitlist, with Meta Ads' and HubSpot's own etas now past due in the catalog copy itself. Still no Meta Ads MCP page (or the other 8) without your call on which are actually ready today.

Next: two more blog posts (a GA4-specific setup walkthrough and/or an agency-owner churn-risk piece). Static-rendering the marketing pages remains open and deferred to its own session (9th time flagged). GSC submission and an SE Ranking rank-tracking project for askarlo.app both still need human access. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
